pairs.summary: GMEB2 and HOXC12 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 9 of 14 profiles analysed (A549 lung adenocarcinoma; HT-29 colorectal adenocarcinoma; HepG2 hepatoblastoma/liver cancer; K562 chronic myelogenous leukemia; ...). Median lift 1.81x, typical spacing ~62 bp between sites. In 8 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction.
